No model CRUD or Git prerequisite. FR05: externally read actual archive_path/manifest_path; exact Git dual blobs/hash plus real tar headers/member bytes/links/metadata and declared manifest must equal independent source; actual import+restore uses that archive.

cases.name: historical_exact

cases.name: reference_authority

cases.name: external_structure

cases.name: base_changed

cases.independent_expected: BASE_CHANGED from actual set even when R binding revision unchanged; edit retained

cases.independent_expected: Keep a reference-authority-recognized STOP; first install request whose otherwise valid intent differs only original execution/generation must reject association, with current/staged unchanged. Also reject missing/invalid STOP. No pre-existing request conflict credited.

cases.name: install_reconcile
cases.operation: install accepted intent and repeat/query same ID
cases.independent_expected: current/retired actual devino show single exchange; same resource; original identity reused; mismatched full intent conflict

cases.name: install_crash
cases.operation: SIGKILL after exchange before result recorded; reopen/query
cases.independent_expected: classifies actual old/staged layout from durable intent; never second exchange; roots preserved and no automatic R release

cases.name: domain_restore
cases.operation: surface restore while workspace untouched; then workspace only
cases.independent_expected: Surface and workspace version references/materialized ordinary content remain separate; restoring selected file domain does not change other ordinary domain or external S/E fixture. R restore tuple and real history rollback fact require R/G5, not fixture success.

cases.name: budgets
cases.operation: entry/logical/archive/time explicit bounds at and over
cases.independent_expected: at-limit valid; over-limit fails LIMIT_EXCEEDED without partial confirmation/pin deletion; timeout not skipped

cases.name: root_identity
cases.operation: replace managed root object at same pathname
cases.independent_expected: STALE_BINDING; no permission from string path; raw request mismatch cannot update binding

cases.name: new_writer_break
cases.operation: real subprocess attempts write after leases acquired
cases.independent_expected: Within2s observe atomic original child ready, actual SIGIO and still-blocked writer with unchanged bytes; verification checkpoint then relays original SUT handler. Capture invalidates; release lets original child complete. No fixed sleep inference.
